description: Perimetrazione delle aree con pericolosità da frana derivate dall’inventario dei fenomeni franosi. Livello di dettaglio in scala 1:10.000 (PAI) is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by opendata.comune.fi.it. Information sheet drawn up by the Basin Authority - Hydrogeological Plan and Risk landslides 10ke cut out on a buffer of 500m from the municipal border. Hydrogeological structure pursuant to Law No 267 of 3 August 1998 and Law No 265 of 11 December 2000.Restriction of use: The data is also available at. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Perimeter of landslide hazard areas derived from the inventory of landslides. Level of detail 1:10,000 scale (PAI)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include autorità di bacino, open data, arno. The listing shows 4 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
